name: dsh-cluster-ssh
description: LSF cluster execution channel for DeepSeek Harness over the system OpenSSH client: one authenticated interactive session, reused for fast subsequent commands, with sentinel-delimited output and ANSI/echo noise stripped. macOS/Linux build uses a pure-POSIX sh askpass helper.

plugin.note: Host-plane tool plugin. Requires the system 'ssh' and 'scp' clients on PATH (/usr/bin on macOS) and a saved connection in $DSH_HOME/dsh-ssh-connections.json; the TOTP secret lives in $DSH_HOME/dsh-ssh-totp.json and is never committed. The askpass helper is generated on first connect as a 0700 POSIX sh script and needs no Node interpreter.
